label: rem:commutative-qou-remark
title: The strictly commutative case as the classical limit
html: Strict commutativity isolates the classical limit q \to 1: it restricts the gauge group to \mathrm{SU}(2) and turns \mathrm{Rep}(\mathbf{C}) into a symmetric category. A strictly commutative quantum observable universe hosts the classical hyperelliptic quintic, but cannot support anyonic structure.
